Reliable & Responsive HVAC & Electrical Experts Serving Lane County & the Surrounding Areas

If you’ve been hunting for reliable HVAC and electrical professionals to handle your home’s comfort, you’ve come to the right place. At Associated Heating & Air Conditioning, we’ve been serving the needs of homeowners throughout our service areas for over 45 years. We make it our mission to earn the complete satisfaction and trust of every customer.

When you choose our licensed, insured, and highly trained technicians, you can expect:
24/7 emergency support
100% money-back guarantee within the first two years of any HVAC installation
“No lemon” guarantee on the systems we install
Upfront and transparent pricing
Detail-oriented service

Put simply, we aim to exceed your expectations on every job, whether you need an urgent AC repair or indoor air quality solutions. We stand behind every aspect of our services, including our products, workmanship, sales, and performance. Ask about our warranties and financing options!

When you need a dependable heating, air conditioning, and electrical company in Eugene, OR, call (541) 250-3845 or contact us online. We offer free estimates.

Join the A+ Club and Protect Your Investment

Your HVAC system is a significant investment, and it needs regular care to perform at its best and last for years. Our A+ Club Memberships make getting cooling and heating maintenance easy. Becoming a member helps you protect your investment, save money on energy bills, and avoid unexpected breakdowns.

Benefits include:
A discount on repairs
Discounted diagnostic fees
Priority service

During routine maintenance visits, our technicians perform comprehensive inspections and tune-ups. We clean your coils, check refrigerant levels, inspect electrical components, and test all functions to make sure your systems are running as efficiently as possible. Our experts can find and address minor issues before they become major, costly problems. Regular maintenance also increases your equipment’s efficiency, which translates to real savings on your monthly utility bills. A well-maintained system doesn't have to work as hard and uses less energy.

Generators
GFCI and AFCI outlets
Indoor and outdoor lighting
Surge protection systems
Water heaters

Enjoy peace of mind with our 100% money-back guarantee. We are confident the equipment we install for you will perform beyond your expectations. However, if you are not fully satisfied with your new system’s performance, our services, or even our team within two years of the installation, we will remove the equipment within 30 days of your request and gladly refund the entire amount of the contract.

Remember, we’re available 24/7 for emergencies, so don’t wait to call (541) 250-3845 or book a service appointment online if you think something may be seriously wrong with your heating, cooling, or electrical equipment.
